text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — drafting a long-horizon plan for routing, multi-region, and tenant isolation. want to align on launch criteria and how customer asks map to phases. propose 3 phases. short feedback pls.

Leo (Arch): curious — what are the non-negotiable launch gates? sla numbers, rollout window, and which customers must be supported day 1?

Maya (PM): thinking gates: 99.9% regional availability for hosted, <100ms p50 cold-start for top-tier routes, documented fallback policy + canary UX, and at least two enterprise customers validated on dedicated slices.

Sam (Eng): sounds ok but <100ms p50 is tough for cross-region fallback. suggest we separate latency SLOs by routing lane: local-affinity vs global-failover.

Priya (SRE): +1. Also need playbooks for tenant quarantine and automated rollback triggers. operational cost to run slice-per-tenant is exponential, so we need strict launch criteria for hard isolation.

Ken (Sales): customers asking for "isolated tenant per contract" frequently. they care about provable isolation (network + KV separation), audit logs, and predictable throughput. willing to sign only if we can guarantee capacity reservation.

Maya (PM): proposal: Phase A (12 months) — routing guardrails, routing templates, region affinity flags, soft tenancy (logical slices), standardized fallback templates. Phase B (18–30 months) — tenant slices with quota/affinity, SLA tiers, canary tooling. Phase C (30–48 months) — hard isolation (VPC-onprem patterns + appliance), migration playbooks, compliance artifacts.

Leo (Arch): nice. for Phase A we should define an explicit policy schema. rough draft below: 
```json
{
  "route_name": "regional-affinity",
  "priority": 10,
  "affinity": "region-preferred",
  "fallback_chain": ["same-region-variant","cross-region-compacted"],
  "isolation": "soft",
  "sla_profile": "standard"
}
```
This lets us validate routing templates and simulate rollouts.

Sam (Eng): we also need a matrix mapping model variants to latency/cost profiles for each region/hardware. Optimize routing decisions at request time.

Maya (PM): agree. we'll add a required artifact for each route: perf matrix + cost delta table. Eg: "gptx-1-8q": p50 40ms (us-west:g5), p50 62ms (eu-west:a100), cost +12%.

Priya (SRE): launch checklist idea for Phase B: 
- automated tenant slice creation + teardown
- eviction & soft-quarantine flow tested
- per-slice observability (tokens, latency, errors) retained 90d
- disaster recovery: region failover tested with synthetic traffic
- canary rollback timing <= 5m

Leo (Arch): scope negotiation: customers asking for predictable throughput + private deploys will extend Phase B into Phase C if we commit to reserved capacity. We should avoid promising hard isolation timelines until we have capacity model validated.

Ken (Sales): can we offer "dedicated slices" as an interim commercial product (soft isolation + reserve)? customers would pay for predictable latency and simpler compliance.

Maya (PM): yes, that maps to Dedicated offering but we need to define technical guarantees. possible productized definition: "Dedicated Slice (beta)" = logical tenant slice + guaranteed GPU capacity slice + per-tenant quotas + separate billing. no VPC until Phase C.

Sam (Eng): technical risks to call out: stateful KV cache leakage across slices, model weights sharing, network egress mixing. need infra tests that run mem/kv fuzz for 48h.

Priya (SRE): ops cost estimate request: what is the overhead of maintaining n dedicated slices vs dynamic multi-tenant packing? we need a cost curve to use in prioritization.

Maya (PM): action items:
- Leo: produce policy schema + template library for Phase A (due 2w)
- Sam: perf-matrix spec and simulation harness (due 3w)
- Priya: ops checklist + DR playbook skeleton (due 3w)
- Ken: collect top-5 enterprise asks and revenue signals (due 2w)

Leo (Arch): ack. will include validation harnesses for fallback chain in template library.

Sam (Eng): will prototype perf-matrix csv + simulator. quick question: any opinion on routing decision runtime? syncronous policy eval or precomputed routing table?

Maya (PM): prefer precomputed routing decisions with periodic recompute to keep p99 down. dynamic overrides allowed for emergency.

Priya (SRE): add: implement traffic shaping playground so we can test tenant QoS degradation without customer impact.

Ken (Sales): I'll surface the Dedicated Slice (beta) proposition to two strategic accounts next week.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Architecture — routing + isolation roadmap" Thu 10am in #conf-arch (auto-created). :calendar:

Maya (PM): thanks all. next sync in two weeks to review Phase A templates and perf matrix examples. if anyone wants to add items to the checklist, drop them here. :thumbsup:
